*In European Union jurisdictions, Temos International cannot, for regulatory reasons, award accreditation to a healthcare organization in European Union countries. An organization that has been assessed against Temos International standards and has been found to meet the standards will, in those jurisdictions, be awarded a certificate as an “Assessed Organization”.

The assessment has been conducted according to the same standards and by the same methodology as in other jurisdictions, and the criteria for achieving an award are the same.
